1.title: Court Pauses Execution of Christa Pike, Tennessee’s Lone Woman on Death Row
1.summary: Christa Pike tortured and murdered a classmate in 1995. She had been set to die on Wednesday, the first woman executed in the state in 200 years.

2.title: Congress Set to Leave Washington for the Midterms With No A.I. Progress
2.summary: Senate Democrats were expected on Wednesday to block a measure that would encourage, but not require, states to protect consumers from power rate hikes as a result of data center growth.

3.title: What we know about Cornell University frat house rape investigation
3.summary: The woman alleges she was drugged and raped at a fraternity house at the university two years ago.

4.title: UK Believes Iran Played a Part in RAF Fairford Air Base Incident, Burnham Says
4.summary: The British prime minister, Andy Burnham, said there were “strong indications” Iran played a part in the events at R.A.F. Fairford on Sunday, without providing details why.

5.title: Live Updates: Passengers Arrive in Israel After Cockpit Clash on FlyDubai Flight
5.summary: Passengers intervened and “prevented a disaster” after one pilot stabbed another during a flight from Dubai, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said. The motive for the attack was not clear.

6.title: Hundreds Detained in France as Some Student Protests Turn Violent
6.summary: French high schoolers are protesting teacher shortages and overcrowded classrooms, in France’s latest flare-up over education and public services.
